description: This file defines types, interfaces, and constants related to eviction management in Kubernetes kubelet, including configuration, pressure detection, garbage collection, and cgroup notifications.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for eviction management, including pressure transition period, pod grace period, thresholds, kernel notification, and cgroup root.

classes.name: Manager
classes.description: Interface for evaluating node pressure conditions and starting eviction threshold monitoring.

classes.name: DiskInfoProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing disk configuration details such as dedicated image and container filesystems.

classes.name: ImageGC
classes.description: Interface for garbage collecting unused images.

classes.name: ContainerGC
classes.description: Interface for garbage collecting unused containers.

classes.name: KillPodFunc
classes.description: Function type for killing a pod with specified parameters and callback.

classes.name: MirrorPodFunc
classes.description: Function type for retrieving mirror pods.

classes.name: ActivePodsFunc
classes.description: Function type for retrieving active pods.

classes.name: PodCleanedUpFunc
classes.description: Function type for checking if a pod's resources have been reclaimed.

classes.name: statsFunc
classes.description: Function type for retrieving resource usage stats for a pod.

classes.name: rankFunc
classes.description: Function type for sorting pods in eviction order.

classes.name: signalObservation
classes.description: Struct representing observed resource usage including capacity, available amount, and timestamp.

classes.name: signalObservations
classes.description: Map of signals to their observed resource usage.

classes.name: thresholdsObservedAt
classes.description: Map of thresholds to the time they were observed.

classes.name: nodeConditionsObservedAt
classes.description: Map of node condition types to the time they were observed.

classes.name: nodeReclaimFunc
classes.description: Function type for reclaiming resources from the node.

classes.name: nodeReclaimFuncs
classes.description: Slice of nodeReclaimFunc, representing an ordered list of reclaim functions.

classes.name: CgroupNotifier
classes.description: Interface for generating events from cgroup threshold crossings.

classes.name: NotifierFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating CgroupNotifier instances.

classes.name: ThresholdNotifier
classes.description: Interface for managing cgroup memory eviction threshold notifications and actions.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the control loop or notifier process.

methods.name: UpdateThreshold
methods.description: Updates the memory cgroup threshold based on current metrics.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string describing the memory threshold notifier.
